experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit status mapping in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay incorrectly calculates the exit code for SIGINT by adding 15 instead of 2 to the base 128, resulting in 143 instead of the expected 130.
experiment.falsifier: Running the same probe_process with expectedExit=130 will fail if the fix is incorrect or if the signal handling logic differs from a simple arithmetic mapping.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Restores compliance with the relay's contract to preserve child exit status, matching shell conventions (SIGINT=128+2=130).

limits: A reported issue is not permission to contact its author, endorsement, demand validation or evidence that our product solves it.
